ROBUST TRACKING CONTINUATION — RESTRICTED CONSTRUCTION, GENERAL GATE OPEN
13 October 2026. Owner: sol02_tracking.

PRECISE STATUS

The arbitrary pre-supplied schedule target is NOT CLOSED. There is no proved
polynomial-dimension general winning representation or general efficient causal
compiler here. This continuation obtains a useful explicit growing-dimension
structural class, an executable finite certificate, and an all-time factorized
lift of the inherited continuous controller. None establishes a new civilization
capability or priority. The methods are classical robust safety DP, orthogonal
decomposition, and scalar error feedback; novelty is UNKNOWN and no advantage
over those methods is asserted.

The new theorem is: when every supplied direction is supported in one of
disjoint coordinate blocks of dimension at most a FIXED r, the inherited
arbitrary-schedule existence theorem gives a causal robust compiler polynomial
in explicit horizon N, original rational input bit length, and 1/(1-gamma), with
degree depending on r. Its radius is O((1-gamma)^-3 sqrt(d)). Its measurement and
arithmetic precision have polynomial bit length. The runtime is NOT polynomial
in variable r or in log(1/(1-gamma)). This is therefore a restricted fixed-local-
dimension result, not the missing general polynomial-bit compiler.

The concrete all-time operation is independent of the general existence theorem:
for k orthogonal two-coordinate blocks, each following the inherited four-
direction period, a single shared 7 KiB compressed certificate controls arbitrary
interleavings forever with actual Euclidean radius 3 sqrt(k)=3 sqrt(d/2), under
postdecision scalar drift in [-1/2,1/2] and active-coordinate feedback error
<=1/20. It uses k local phase indices and one table lookup per pulse. The local
certificate is inherited, not newly synthesized here; the factorized composition
and executable wrapper are the continuation's construction. No tensor-product
state enumeration is needed.

The finite-horizon compiler in RESULT.txt is mathematically sound for its

all-schedules radius theorem in mathematical_operation/PROOF. Its exact
rounding, scalar-noise alphabet, lattice embedding, and blockwise causal
composition close. The claimed radius remains O((1-gamma)^-3 sqrt(d)); for

explicit horizon N, rational input bit length, and 1/(1-gamma), with a degree

The current proof/compiler statement is specifically about disjoint
coordinate-support blocks. A general *rational orthogonal-subspace* version
is also valid by the weighted-basis construction below, but is not what the
current finite-horizon code executes. discover_orthogonal_blocks.py supplies
an exact dense example and useful basis machinery; it is not a general
finite-horizon compiler implementation. block_controller.py and
periodic_block_lift.py instead establish an executable product for the
particular inherited 2D periodic controller. Keep these three evidence scopes
separate.

1. COORDINATE-BLOCK COMPILER CHECK

For a local block of dimension r>=1 and length n>=1, let M=ceil(8nr),
round each coordinate of Mv to a nearest integer z, and set
vbar=2z/(2M+r). Then ||z-Mv||_2<=sqrt(r)/2. Therefore

  ||vbar|| <= (2M+sqrt(r))/(2M+r) <= 1,
  ||vbar-v|| <= (sqrt(r)+r)/(2M+r) <= r/M <= 1/(8n).

All inequalities are exact; the middle bounds use sqrt(r)<=r. The extra r in
the denominator is the norm-restoring normalization, not an approximation.

LUNA01 — ALL-PREFIX FRACTIONAL COMPLETION AND SELECTOR CLOSURE
13 October 2026. Exact local counterexample; no general complexity result.

Question

Can a polynomial-time separation oracle for a compact, convex, all-prefix
completion body supply causal signs when each scalar drift is chosen after the
sign? The inherited game has a supplied fixed direction schedule v_1,...,v_N,
||v_t||_2<=1, action epsilon_t in {-1,+1}, then adversarial zeta_t in
[-gamma,gamma], gamma<1, with s_t=s_(t-1)+(epsilon_t+zeta_t)v_t. Exact past
state is available before each choice. The source-derived theorem is an
existence result with radius O((1-gamma)^-3 sqrt(d)); its supplied compiler is
not polynomial in dimension.

A precise sufficient oracle condition

For a safe convex body B_R and each time t, suppose a controller has convex
sets Q_t and selector regions C_t^+, C_t^- with:
  (i) s_0 in Q_1 and every Q_t is contained in B_R;
  (ii) Q_t is covered by C_t^+ union C_t^-;
  (iii) for every s in C_t^epsilon, both endpoint states
       s+(epsilon-gamma)v_t and s+(epsilon+gamma)v_t lie in Q_(t+1).
If Q_(N+1) is contained in B_R, then choose the sign whose selector region
contains the observed state. Convexity of Q_(t+1) puts the whole scalar segment
s+(epsilon+[-gamma,gamma])v_t inside Q_(t+1), so induction keeps every prefix
inside B_R. With separation/membership oracles for these sets and a dispatch
rule for the two selector regions, execution uses a constant number of oracle
queries per round. This is a sufficient, independently checkable format for a
causal policy. It does not construct the sets or prove their coverage cheaply.

The tempting all-prefix fractional relaxation is
  P_(N+1)=B_R,
  A_t = B_R intersect union_(epsilon=+-1)
        {s: s+(epsilon-gamma)v_t and s+(epsilon+gamma)v_t are in P_(t+1)},
  P_t=conv(A_t).
Thus each step admits a sign into the next fractional body, then convexifies
the resulting predecessor states. Exact viability instead obeys
  W_(N+1)=B_R,
  W_t = B_R intersect union_(epsilon=+-1)
        {s: s+(epsilon+zeta)v_t is in W_(t+1) for every zeta in [-gamma,gamma]}.
